interpretation.policy_identity_rule: Version strings are not sufficient if policy bytes can change under the same version. A safe grandfather path binds the exact old policy hash in current authority; a safe migration path re-evaluates under the exact current policy hash.
interpretation.minor_version_rule: A same-major/minor-compatible parsing contract does not by itself preserve a previous ALLOW/terminal decision. Old artifacts may be semantically correct but incomplete for a stricter current verifier, so current acceptance must still be checked or explicitly grandfathered.
interpretation.result_identity_rule: Acceptance identity must include the exact policy hash (old grandfathered hash or current re-verification hash). Reusing a result identity across policy changes permits stale replay to masquerade as current acceptance.
interpretation.hybrid_candidate: Current sanitized authority may either explicitly allowlist an exact historical policy hash, or the verifier may re-evaluate the artifact and complete embedded evidence under the exact current deterministic local policy hash. Any external-fact/all-role scope without explicit grandfather authority fails closed.
interpretation.current_repository_gap: The frozen root/role config does not expose a generic exact-historical-policy-hash grandfather registry. Therefore that branch is a generic architecture candidate/unresolved control-surface child, not claimed as a currently deployed repository capability. Current-policy re-evaluation remains usable only where the predicate is locally decidable from allowed inputs.

zero_dependency_zero_quota_assessment.repository_transport: sanitized current control/config plus role-local immutable artifacts only

unresolved_children: generic exact-historical-policy-hash allowlist is not present in frozen control/config
complete authority-domain rollback remains outside this leaf: if repository authority and all remembered state roll back together, current-hash identity cannot prove a later policy ever existed
policy evolution that changes the predicate to require external facts or all-role completeness remains nonterminal unless exact current authority explicitly grandfathers the old proof
exact_continuation: Next leaf: policy revocation and grandfather-compaction without a global historical allowlist. Compare per-artifact current re-verification, compact revocation floor keyed by predicate family, exact policy-hash tombstone set, Bloom/approximate revocation negative control, and immutable acceptance receipt under policy deletion/recreate, hash collision assumption, role-local state loss, response loss and full repository rollback. Target a self-local zero-quota revocation proof that does not require enumerating other-role artifacts.
